question: Gugga Naumi is mainly celebrated in which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Haryana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Gugga Naumi is a snake-worshipping festival.
 
• The religious festival is celebrated in **Haryana** in the month of August and September (navami of Bhadron).
 
• The festival Guggaa Naumi is celebrated to honor Gugga Ji, a warrior king.
 
• It is a three-day fair.
 
• Gugga Navami is the festival celebrated on the day after Krishna Janmashtami dedicated to the Serpent God, Guga
